responsibility: Defines the shared option flags that control CFI type-id generation semantics and exposes the module’s public API for computing type metadata identifiers from either a function ABI or a monomorphized instance through the selected Itanium C++ ABI implementation.
same_name_distinction: This `mod.rs` is the CFI type-id facade and shared options layer: it defines `TypeIdOptions` and forwards calls to the Itanium backend. Unlike `cfi/typeid/itanium_cxx_abi/mod.rs`, it does not implement encoding itself, and unlike the top-level `cfi/mod.rs` or `kcfi/mod.rs`, it is specific to type-id configuration rather than just crate/module re-export boundaries.
